spans.s: † 2. लज् लज्, and लञ्ज् लञ्ज्, i. 1,

. To fry.
 2. To calumniate, to blame.
† 3. लज् लज्, and लञ्ज् लञ्ज्, i. 10, Par. To appear, to shine.
† 4. लज् लज्, i. 10, Par. To cover (v. r.).
लज्ज् (akin to रञ्ज्, and for original रज्य), and लज् लज् (Bhaṭṭ. 14, 105), i. 6, Ātm. (also Par.,
), To be ashamed, Pañc. ii. d. 106; with the ptcple. pres. in the sense of the infin.,

; Pañc. 119, 6. (ब्रुवाणो न लज्जसे, You are not ashamed to speak).
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. लग्न, Ashamed.
 --With the prep. वि वि, To be ashamed,

लज्ज् + आ, f.
 1. Shame, Pañc. v. d. 10.
 2. Bashfulness, Pañc. v. d. 83.
 3. Modesty.
 --Comp.
लज्जा + वन्त्, adj., f. वती, Bashful, modest,
लज्जित, i. e. लज्जा + इत, adj. Ashamed, bashful, Utt.
